description: North-bound capital surge and its implications for A-share stocks
context: User asking about interpreting sudden north-bound capital inflows or outflows.
user_input_examples: 北向资金突然大幅流入，要不要跟？
外资连续净卖出意味着什么？

structure.suggestion: How to position based on north-bound signals
structure.risks: Flow reversal risk and data lag

key_principles: Single-day surge may be index rebalancing; need 3+ consecutive days for trend confirmation
North-bound buying concentrates in large-cap and sector leaders, not small caps
Sell-off in north-bound during rising market = bearish divergence, be cautious
Historical data: north-bound has ~60% accuracy as a short-term timing indicator
Track which sectors receive the flows, not just the aggregate number

decision_tree.if_consecutive_3day_inflow_and_market_up: Follow the trend, focus on north-bound-favored sectors
decision_tree.if_persistent_outflow_in_rising_market: Reduce position, smart money may be exiting
